meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me.
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Owen found out on his phone, in the middle of a class. What do you have, Hale?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down that you asked him about a word and a paragraph. Show me the note you wrote that day, with the date on it. Is that all you have?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
I'm writing that down, Hale. A student who changes his argument between an outline and an essay is revising, not cheating. Show me both pages.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

I'm writing down "nothing goes on his record." I want that in writing before Thursday at 8:15, not Friday at 3 PM, and I still haven't seen the outline and the essay side by side. Who decides whether it "holds up," Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the supervised rewrite offer and the promise that nothing goes on Owen's record in writing, the outline and the essay shown to me side by side, and a name for who decides whether the rewrite holds up. I expect all of it in writing before Thursday at 8:15.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the fallback position, with nothing on Owen's record taken in as your offer, but no agreement yet, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the offer in writing before Thursday at 8:15, the pages shown, and a named decision-maker.
What moved her: "That was my mistake." owning the zero before the call, in one sentence, with no defence, got you a flat okay and her first small ground.
What cost ground: "If it holds up" left the judgment with you and gave her something to attack, and you made the offer before showing her the outline and the essay.
Try next time: when you say the essay never mentions cowardice, put the outline and the essay in front of her right then, before you offer anything.
